title: Minimizing integer multiplicity cycles in ℝ^P are stationary (Simon 7.1.2, flat case)
lean_statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → R.Represents C → C.support.Nonempty → ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0
